runtime_topology: one backend process with logical in-process Builder sessions; isolated command/check containers only
model_selection_gate: explicit compatible account/model with caller-owned history, tools, streaming terminal status and observed usage; no automatic paid probe
credential_route: env:OPENAI_API_KEY read by coordinator only; never inherited by tool containers

budgets.unknown_request_policy: pause and reconcile; no automatic resubmission; retain conservative token reservation

capture_policy.critical_intent_and_terminal_outcome: SQL/artifact durable acknowledgement required before effects/dependent success
capture_policy.partial_stream_policy: partial/gap visible; no zero-loss claim for unacknowledged deltas
capture_policy.sql_outage_policy: stop new admission and reconcile active command; no mandatory offline spool

checkpoint_policy.source: checkpoint-manifest-v1 immutable artifact referenced by Source and TaskState
checkpoint_policy.capture_watermark: covered_capture_positions per session after source admission; never supplied by model
checkpoint_policy.overflow: block until deterministic checkpoint/reconciliation covers critical events; never silently take last N

retrieval.procedure_seed: ProjectRoot HAS_PROCEDURE with matching approved fixture family/name/preconditions
retrieval.proof_vs_advice: proof requires exact current candidate/criteria/environment/revision; advice requires declared compatible semantic conditions and never satisfies completion

source_inspection.authorization: source availability/scope and session grants checked on every range; no raw artifact path access

local_auth.bootstrap: owner-only local file/socket, random token hash in user_sessions

diagnose.purpose: observed diagnostic on current candidate, not completion authority
diagnose.stdin: published case input; service-selected, not arbitrary code
diagnose.result: actual output/exit code; comparison is diagnostic, not completion proof

build.purpose: node syntax check for src/exporter.mjs; registered fixed argv

verify.purpose: trusted manifest assertions outside candidate process; receipt only from service actor
verify.dispatch: trusted supervisor executes all applicable protected cases for current accepted criteria
verify.candidate_argv: same registered exporter argv as diagnose; each protected input supplied outside candidate
verify.result: service receipt or blocked/unknown; no editable npm script as authority

external_prerequisites.reason: choose maintained compatible patches/images/model and record actual doctor/preflight output before claiming support

execution_sandbox.termination_gate: container stopped and immutable snapshot reconciled; uncertain stop quarantines candidate and blocks replacement
execution_sandbox.trusted_supervisor: outside candidate container; no receipt writing from candidate outputs alone

coordination_timing.automatic_retry: only known no-effect/replay-safe operation; ambiguous graph/provider/tool outcome reconciles first
coordination_timing.lease_expiry: revokes admission only; does not establish execution termination
coordination_timing.lease_clock: coordinator-controlled clock; persist deadline and reject stale fence
